name: Chi Tu Yangguang Ban
source: Remake of [url=/v37713]Qianfu: Chi Tu[/url]. Most of the real person photographs are replaced and the negative description in the original work is eliminated to make the main theme more positive.
translation: 這是[url=/v37713]《潛伏之赤途》[/url]的重製版。作品替換了大部分真人照片，並刪去了原作中的負面描述，使主題更加積極。
